stageA.warmUp: Notice and Wonder favorite pets: picture graph vs bar graph shows the same category counts (cat 6, dog 10, fish 5, lizard 3). Interpret bar heights using a numbered vertical scale.
stageA.activity1: Groups read different classroom field-trip-choice bar graphs; author several mathematically true statements, combine/compare categories, and identify which classroom graph was discussed.
stageA.activity2: Our Favorite Seasons source heights winter7 spring3 summer13 fall3; ask summer, spring+fall, all pairs with total ten, and whole count; learner uses bar scale.
stageA.sourceSynthesis: Describe why a bar graph's numbered scale simplifies counting versus picture symbols; teacher observes group discussion and actual student-generated statements
stageA.originalCoolDown: Publisher Animals at the Zoo restricted; independent original Edulytics school-club Cool-down authored, not presented as publisher assessment
stageA.charts: First-party CSS rectangles and semantic accessible text: no publisher image reuse. Fictional class A/B graphs explicitly described as hypothetical rather than real class observations.

stageB.sourceGuard: 2021 preparation URL, original canonical body SHA and 2.MD.D.10, prior exact English fields plus prior published content version
stageB.improvedTeaching: Read numbered scale, differentiate same-data picture graph/bar graph, field-trip classroom labels, source multiple valid seasonal pairs and total 26

stageC.studentGradePolicy: Immediate numeric/checker feedback does not persist official school grades and does not substitute teacher assessment of original written statements and partner discourse.

closure.note: Authoring-only sequential gate, technical correctness and runtime tests remain to be determined during Stage D.
